records.description: - Browse public Minecraft skins - Preview skins in 3D before downloading - Download standard 64×64 skin PNGs - Remix public skins into editable projects - Search skins by color palette and visual style - Generate cleaner render-style previews with backgrounds, gradients, lighting, shadows, and poses - Create cover-style images for sharing

records.name: SignalShield
records.tagline: Trader discipline software for TradingView alerts
records.description: SignalShield helps traders add structure around execution with TradingView alert workflows, automated lock rules, cooldowns, and execution tracking. It is built for active traders who want stronger discipline infrastructure, clearer accountability, and more control when pressure hits.

records.name: BharatERP
records.tagline: All-in-One Free ERP for Small Businesses
records.description: BharatERP is India’s free GST billing & accounting software built for SMEs. Unlike traditional tools, it works both online and offline with zero learning curve. Manage invoices, inventory, accounting, POS, and reports in one system. Industry-specific modules for retail, restaurant, pharmacy & more. Trusted by 5,000+ businesses. Fast setup, no complexity, real business control.

records.name: CozyJobs
records.tagline: The best jobs and opps. AI auto-apply. One cozy home.
records.description: CozyJobs is the only job platform combining full-time, remote, hybrid, fractional, and freelance roles in one place. Subscribe and unlock CozyApply — our AI browser extension that writes your cover letter and auto-applies in one click.

records.name: Sellium
records.tagline: Launch a digital store with modern checkout
records.description: Sellium is a digital-first ecommerce platform for sellers, creators, and online service businesses. Create a hosted storefront, add products and variants, accept payments, manage orders, and deliver a clean checkout experience. Built for digital products, services, memberships, software, templates, and creator-led stores.

records.name: WheelPage
records.tagline: Tiny decision tools for everyday choices
records.description: WheelPage is a simple collection of browser-based decision tools. Spin a wheel, flip a coin, and make small choices quickly without accounts, setup, or unnecessary friction.

records.name: uihtml – Screenshot to HTML
records.tagline: seconds, not hours
records.description: uihtml turns screenshots, designs, or text prompts into clean, shippable HTML — instantly. Tired of manually translating designs into code? Just upload a screenshot or describe what you want, and get production-ready HTML in seconds. Built for developers, designers, and indie makers who want to move fast and ship faster. No more redrawing layouts. No more wasted hours on mockups. Just upload, generate, and ship. Try it — your next project ships faster.

records.name: Cek Prospek
records.tagline: Indonesian Lead Generations & Simple CRM for SME's
records.description: Elevate your sales strategy with Cek Prospect’s advanced lead management platform. Our intuitive tools streamline your processes, allowing you to quickly find, manage, and engage with prospects. Organize leads effortlessly, track interactions, and optimize your outreach to turn potential clients into loyal customers. Say goodbye to the guesswork in lead management and watch your sales soar. Experience the transformation today!

records.name: Ai tool builder
records.tagline: Turn ideas into working Ai tools instantly
records.description: A Ai product that create Ai tools just by giving prompt and help user to increase there sales automate task and much more user can come and can create any kind of working Ai tool just by giving prompt No Api no crawling internet just prompt and it will automate any kind of task that user want and will build a tool also to complete the work.

records.name: Clawdscore
records.tagline: Find out if your brand is visible to ChatGPT, Claude. in 10s
records.description: Most brands are invisible to ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity — AI agents simply can't read their websites. ClawdScore scans any URL against 10 factors AI agents use to discover and recommend brands: structured data, crawler permissions, sitemaps, content depth, HTTPS, citations, and more. Get your AI-Ready Score (0-100) in 10 seconds. Free. No signup. PoreLab: 12/100 → 85/100 in 1 week. Zero ad spend. https://clawdscore.netlify.app

records.name: PDF Forge
records.tagline: Create PDFs from anything — all in your browser.
records.description: A free, private, browser-based tool to merge images and PDFs into one high-quality PDF. No uploads. No accounts. No nonsense. Support for Docx and Xlsx with more features is coming soon.

records.name: PromptVault
records.tagline: Never lose a great AI prompt again.
records.description: You write the perfect prompt. Close the tab. It's gone. PromptVault lets you save, tag, and find your best prompts instantly — no more rewriting from memory. Built for anyone using ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini daily. 👉 Free to use: https://promptvault29.bolt.host

records.name: globaloilshock.com — Oil
records.tagline: How much will rising oil prices really cost you
records.description: What’s new or different? Most oil price tools are built for traders and analysts. Global Oil Shock Calculator is made for normal households. It shows in just 30 seconds exactly how much the next oil crisis will personally cost you — in fuel, heating, groceries and daily life. Standout features: Live Brent crude price (updated every minute) Personalized 12-month calculation for your country, car & household Scenario planner (Hormuz, Iran escalation etc.) 100% free, no sign-up

records.name: tailk.me
records.tagline: Your AI presence, live in minutes.
records.description: Don't send a CV. Start a conversation and let your AI tell who you are.

records.name: Geography Practice
records.tagline: Improve your geography knowledge through interactive quizzes
records.description: Master world geography through fun, interactive quizzes. Learn countries, capitals, flags, and US states with instant feedback and educational facts. Geography Practice is a quiz-based learning platform designed to help students and curious learners strengthen their knowledge of countries, capitals, flags, and world geography.

records.name: NotedPin - Save and share knowledge
records.tagline: Organize your saved content into clear learning systems
records.description: NotedPin helps you save, organize, and actually use your content. Most tools help you collect links. NotedPin helps you structure them. Save anything, organize into Boards, and turn your resources into clear, step-by-step learning paths you can revisit or share. No clutter. Just structured knowledge.

records.name: CromaFlow
records.tagline: CromaFlow: 3-20 tone scales with Light/Dark preview
records.description: Create perfect color palettes for Tailwind CSS with CromaFlow. Advanced tool for designers and developers: OKLCH generator, WCAG accessibility checker, and JSON export to Figma.

records.name: VConnect: Volvo Track your Car
records.tagline: Control your Volvo from your Wear OS smartwatch
records.description: VConnect is the leading standalone Wear OS app for Volvo owners, bringing remote start, climate control, lock/unlock, live GPS vehicle tracking, and real-time car status directly to your smartwatch—no phone required. Built for speed, convenience, and true on-wrist Volvo control.

records.name: MVLESS
records.tagline: A music video guessing game
records.description: Challenge your music knowledge with MVLESS. Watch short video snippets, guess the track, and score big with early answers. Unlimited fun for music lovers.

records.name: Blink URLs
records.tagline: ⚡ Edge-native link intelligence with AI-driven ROI insights.
records.description: BlinkURLs is built for speed and scale. Unlike traditional shorteners that add 500ms+ of latency, our edge-native engine ensures sub-50ms redirects globally. 🚀 What's New: 🤖 AI Strategist: Real-time telemetry analysis via Gemini 2.0. ⚡ Edge-Native: Redirections happen at the global edge. 🛡️ Guardian Monitor: Automated destination health checks. 📊 ROI Intelligence: Built-in calculator for marketing profit tracking.

records.name: AIListingTool
records.tagline: Marketing, AI Tools Directory, AI Tool Submission
records.description: AIListingTool helps AI creators reach 100K+ monthly users worldwide. Submit your tool to gain instant visibility, high-quality backlinks, and social media promotion. Connect with founders, marketers, and businesses actively searching for AI solutions, and accelerate your growth with a platform built to showcase innovation.

records.name: LiftCalc
records.tagline: Gym calculator
records.description: Liftcalc is a gym app with a multitude of calculators for all your gym strength needs. This is my first app ive created looking for feedback! Thank you all for your time.

records.name: Thumbnailed
records.tagline: Generate YouTube thumbnails straight from your video.
records.description: Drop your finished video. We watch and analyse it, then generate 3 YouTube thumbnail concepts in about 4 minutes. First one free, no prompt to write.

records.name: EticAlert
records.tagline: Canal de denuncias
records.description: Activa tu canal de denuncias en minutos. EticAlert es la plataforma para pymes: segura, conforme a la Ley 2/2023, gratis hasta 20 empleados. Sin llamadas, sin complicaciones.

records.name: AI Meme Party Game - Sketchy Friends
records.tagline: Roast your friends with AI memes
records.description: Play with friends, respond to prompts, and watch AI turn them into hilarious memes. The funniest/sketchiest take wins!

records.name: printMockup
records.tagline: Generate Thousands of mockups in munites
records.description: Still using outdated mockup tools with manual work and layer setup? PrintMockup is designed to remove the complexity of Photoshop mockups. No layers, no setup — just select your files and generate professional mockups in seconds.

records.name: OutRight Store
records.tagline: Best Coding Podcasts for Developers
records.description: Looking for the best coding podcasts? Explore 23 must-listen podcasts for developers covering web development, Python, careers, and tech trends.

records.name: SelectAndTranslate
records.tagline: The translator that helps you stop translating
records.description: You translate the same words over and over but never remember them. The words you memorize from vocab apps never show up in real life. Two systems, neither one works. This tool turns daily translations into vocabulary. Select text in any Windows app, get a GPT-4o popup. Every word is auto-saved with IPA, etymology, and the sentence where you found it. Anki export. OCR for images and subtitles. Words rotate as desktop wallpapers for passive review. Free. No account. No ads. Windows 10+.

records.name: Rank My Applicants
records.tagline: Rank 50 candidates by fit in 20 seconds — AI-powered
records.description: Recruiters spend 3-6 hours screening resumes manually. Rank My Applicants fixes that. Paste a job description. Paste your resumes. Get a ranked shortlist with: → Match scores (0-100) → Interview / Consider / Pass labels → Hiring reasoning per candidate → Red flags and concerns → Personalized outreach messages No signup. No complex setup. Results in seconds. Free to try. Single run $35, plans from $99. Built for recruiters, HR teams, and staffing agencies.

records.name: Calendar Date Generator | Ease Tools
records.tagline: Generate calendar dates with the Calendar Date Generator.
records.description: Generate calendar dates fast with the Calendar Date Generator by Ease Tools. Create organized date lists for scheduling, planning, and testing online.

records.name: CostToBuildHouse
records.tagline: Free construction cost calculator for all 50 US states
records.description: Professional construction cost estimates for all 50 states. 14-category breakdown, labor vs materials, mortgage estimate. Powered by 2026 RSMeans data.

records.name: Blisache
records.tagline: Passkeys as a service
records.description: Blisache is a passwordless authentication web service It let your users authenticate without passwords using a smartphone biometric authentication or a security key We provide client-side packages for integration with : Flutter applications on android, ios, macos, web React-Native applications on android, ios Javascript applications on web HTML on web

records.name: Codeonix
records.tagline: Automate anything with Python + AI
records.description: Codeonix turns any Python script into a powerful desktop automation — triggered by schedules, webhooks, clipboard changes, system events, and 10 more triggers. No server needed.

records.name: Free Unblocked Games School
records.tagline: 30+ Free Unblocked Games for School
records.description: Play 30+ free unblocked games at school. Tetris, Snake, 2048, Wordle & more - free games unblocked, no download or login. Works on Chromebook & iPad!
